abi: The native SDK uses uintptr_t addresses. Slots, tokens, lengths, versions and reply words retain the browser's widths and meanings.
reply: token:u32le,status:u32le,length:u32le,needed:u32le followed by exact opaque payload bytes; no truncation
storage: Owner-readable atomic files under the shared .openagents root, namespace/version/key separated by SDK encoding. At most one pending reply per slot; close discards all pending replies. This stores no signing keys automatically.
